gen-gf-turret-road-gf-source-sans-3: Turret Road draws its round forms like open parentheses, every stroke a pencil that never presses harder. Source Sans 3 brings a plain sans body whose lower bowl in the a opens to breathe, and that is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-special-gothic: Commanding straight-edged strokes lead in Turret Road, all constant and sure of themselves. Special Gothic then does the quieter job, with rounded sans-serif letters that stay open and inviting where the heading stays stern.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-spinnaker: Bold, rounded and sure of itself, Turret Road leads. Spinnaker follows in modern sans-serif with apertures that keep every counter connected to the space outside, so a long passage keeps moving without feeling cramped.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-stick: Commanding round forms, drawn like open parentheses, give Turret Road its presence up top, with a pen-like line that never wavers. Stick does the gentler work below.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-suse: Soft curves with the heft of a rope, and bowls tipped open like a ladle, make SUSE feel approachable right away. And Turret Road stays bold above it, its round parenthesis-like forms giving the sans-serif text a firm, commanding frame.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-suse-mono: Turret Road draws spaghetti-like strokes of constant width, round and bold, with a commanding presence. And SUSE Mono, a sans with open curves and extra space around every letter, keeps a longer passage unhurried and easy to move through.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tajawal: Turret Road runs on a pen-like line with no contrast between stems and joins, and its round forms read like open parentheses. And Tajawal, a sans-serif with a c like a broad open hook, gives that weight a clean, neutral place to land.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tasa-explorer: Bold and technical-pen sharp, Turret Road holds one constant line weight through its round forms. TASA Explorer then softens the page with a clean sans whose curve ends stop like brush strokes lifted early.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tasa-orbiter: Round, commanding and drawn with a plain unmodulated outline, Turret Road makes a bold first impression. And TASA Orbiter, a plain sans with unclogged small counters, keeps a longer passage clean and professional.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-teachers: Round, bold and pen-drawn, Turret Road hits hard with parenthesis-like forms. Teachers works as the delicate counterpart, a sans bent from thin steel rod with ink strokes that taper out before touching.
